text:
marie_sales: Heads-up — Zenith is scheduling a timed POC for next Thursday. They want a hosted ephemeral key and a temporary QPS bump for a 20m live demo (user-facing chat with streaming). Can we support?

devin_soleng: Need numbers: concurrent clients, expected message cadence, avg tokens, and region. Also do they require IP allowlist?

marie_sales: Zenith says ~150 concurrent users, typical burst to ~800 RPS for 3-5 minutes, avg ~90 tokens/request, region: us-east-1. They want the key by Wednesday EOD for integration tests. They can provide subnets for allowlist.

sam_sre: 800 RPS streaming is doable as an ephemeral burst but we should cap total tokens. Suggest scoped key with burst_qps=900, window 30m (10m warmup), total_token_limit=120000000, allowed_models=[redwood-chat-large, redwood-small-chat], telemetry_tag=zenith-demo.

oleg_se: Agree. Also recommend pre-warming redwood-small-chat in us-east-1 and enable prefix KV caching for repetitive prompts they mentioned. Set max_response_tokens=160 to control tail cost.

marta_finance: Need a conservative token estimate and quick cost outline to approve. Tagging finance. Is streaming billed differently?

devin_soleng: Streaming is billed per token same as non-stream but it can increase connection-related tail latencies. Rough worst-case estimate: assume 5m sustained spike at 800 RPS -> 800 * 90 * 300 = 21,600,000 tokens. Add baseline traffic and buffer -> ~50M. We proposed 120M cap to be safe.

marie_sales: They explicitly asked for graceful fallback if we hit limits — prefer automatic model downgrade and a short in-app message explaining reduced fidelity.

sam_sre: Plan: route to redwood-small-chat if 95p latency > 750ms OR error_rate > 1.5%. Also configure rate-limit headers on responses so their client can show a backoff hint.

oleg_se: I'll prepare the scoped key with the following properties: - allowed_endpoints: [/v1/chat, /v1/chat/stream] - allowed_models: [redwood-chat-large, redwood-small-chat] - qps: 900 - total_token_limit: 120000000 - window: 2026-07-08T18:00:00Z/2026-07-08T18:30:00Z - ip_allowlist: provided subnets - telemetry_tag: zenith-demo

quota-bot: Request recorded: TEMP_HOSTED_BURST by marie_sales for Zenith. Request ID: TR-2099999999. Status: awaiting_finance_approval.

marta_finance: I'll review and respond by Tuesday COB. Please include the token estimate and the proposed hard cap. If approved I'll mark the request approved in the system.

devin_soleng: Example curl snippet to give to Zenith (replace <SCOPED_KEY>):

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCOPED_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-large","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}' \
  https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/chat/stream
```

oleg_se: Note: we'll auto-expire the key at end of window. If finance approves earlier we can generate the key and hand it off to marie_sales. I'll also schedule dashboard tiles: qps, token_rate, 95p latency, error_rate and an alert to #eng-oncall.

marie_sales: Thanks all. Zenith expects the key Wed EOD for customer testing. Please prioritize or flag any blockers. :pray:
